description: Figure 4 presents a comparison of runtimes for several models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis displays the model names: “Our Joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks at 50-unit intervals.  Five bars are displayed, each representing a model’s runtime; “Our Joint Framework” is represented by a green bar with a height of approximately 77 seconds, “ChatGPT” by a red bar of approximately 190 seconds, “DeepSeek” by a blue bar of approximately 243 seconds, “LLaMA” by a teal bar of approximately 172 seconds, and “Claude” by a purple bar of approximately 365 seconds. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order. The value for each bar is directly labeled above it.
